cases.case_label: Full-length SVA_F1 (~4.5 kb) with 5' and 3' transductions in EBP exon 2
cases.mechanism_detail: A ~4.5-kb insertion containing a full-length SVA_F1 with 5' and 3' transductions (containing Alu sequence) disrupts EBP exon 2 in a girl and her affected mother; the transcript consequence is not described in the abstract.
cases.quote: whole genome sequencing (WGS) followed by Manta analysis identified a ~ 4.5 kb insertion at EBP exon 2 of both subjects.
